headline: Worked every open item and found the 'You asked' box had been counting our own commits as reader demand; no public feed is built from git any more, and /games/ reads in light theme.

items.title: You asked counts readers, not commits
items.insight: The founder item 'tag an entry' rested on a feedbackSignals figure that was the number of commits keyword-classified into a theme. Receipts now come only from k-anonymous reader choices (k=5); none qualifies yet, so the box is honest-dark.
items.evidence: ship-receipts self-test 26/26 with a commits-are-not-asks negative control; decision sampler observed total 0

items.title: The narrative feed and subscriber push read the reader changelog
items.insight: The web-push notifier would have sent a commit sentence to subscribers. The narrative is built from approved entries, keyed on a git-free id, and its check now compares content instead of counts.
items.evidence: narrative self-test 12/12; notifier dry run shows the approved title; draft tool 11/11

items.title: /games/ status labels pass AA in light theme
items.insight: Inline colours no theme could reach. Measured from rendered pixels with the text hidden to sample the real background; the /membership/ suspicion from a thumbnail measured 4.61:1 and was not a defect.
items.evidence: 1.47 / 1.90 / 2.22 to 5.22 / 6.45 / 6.55; dark, warm and high-contrast unchanged

items.title: Two hand-synced lists are now gate-bound
items.insight: A content-addressed predicate with no shell asset would ship a loader pointing at a 404; changelog answers keys could drift from the sampler's themes. Both now fail loudly.
items.evidence: build-shell-assets predicate check fixture-verified; provenance self-test 11/11 binds the keys

followUps: FOUNDER: restart the Supabase project (command in LATEST_HANDOFF); Desk comments and Vault Member sign-in are down.
Provider-health line on /status/ so an outage reads as an outage, not Checking.
Make build-shell-assets import-safe so its pure helpers can carry a self-test.
blockers: Supabase project fjnpzjjyhnpmunfoycrp cannot reach its database; the agent restart was refused by the session permission policy.
